head: Dosee pill reminder app for iPhone: vitamins and medication in one list
dek: Dosee, a pill reminder and tracker for iPhone and iPad out since 23 November, keeps your vitamins, supplements and medications in one list and logs each dose with one tap. It costs $5.99 once, with no subscription.
details: You set up each item once; the app then sends reminders, warns when a supply runs low and has widgets for the Home Screen and Lock Screen. It needs no account and has no ads or analytics, and the listing says it isn't a medical device. It needs iOS 26.1 or later. The maker is Nicolas Demanez; on 25 November it was #38 among paid Health & Fitness apps on the US App Store.
where: iPhone and iPad (iOS 26.1 or later), $5.99, out since 23 November
means: If you take several pills or supplements a day and lose track of what you've had, the app keeps a log and reminds you, for one payment instead of a monthly plan.
todo: Check that your iPhone runs iOS 26.1 or later before buying. Follow your doctor's instructions for medication; the app only reminds and logs.
